decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk fits the firm's growing flexible-workplace business, was presented consistently on its own page, and carries little cost in a premium configurable range, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.
A chair family close to the core offer is cheap to keep within existing production and channels, and a family structure allows further variants as demand becomes clearer.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory whose value is still uncertain, but they cost little to carry because they reuse rug materials, so the option is kept despite somewhat higher drop risk.
An upholstered sofa from a renowned designer partner sits at the heart of the firm's living-room franchise and gained more website prominence after launch, which signals value being realized.
A high standing table complements the firm's office and conference offer at low incremental cost and matches the trend toward flexible work settings.

Although the rug collection is distant from the core offer, it supports the curated-materials and interior-solutions strategy and remained presented on its own page, so it is kept while its value continues to resolve.
